title: Retire orphaned secrets in the old staging and legacy accounts
description: DELETE NOTHING WITHOUT THE OWNER'S APPROVAL. Names and last-accessed dates verified 2026-10-21 (no values read). Old staging account (no Chatticus stack exists there any more; secrets were left by RETAIN): OperatorKeyD7C0C4F2-3Fvk... (last accessed Oct 14), InvokeKey581783BE-YvSy... (Oct 14), chatticus/staging/oauth/google (Oct 14). Legacy account, Chatticus secrets still owned by stale stacks: InvokeKey581783BE-wdTS... (stack ChatticusThinTurn, Oct 1), OperatorKeyD7C0C4F2-IUHi... (ChatticusThinTurn, Sep 30), InvokeKey581783BE-P6oU... (ChatticusThinTurnStaging, Oct 2), InvokeKey581783BE-YdDX... (ChatticusThinTurnProduction, Oct 12), chatticus/development/oauth/google (Oct 1), chatticus/staging/oauth/google (Oct 2), chatticus/production/oauth/google (Oct 2). The secrets have RETAIN, so deleting their stacks does not delete them; the stacks themselves (ChatticusThinTurn*, ChatticusAuth*, ChatticusWeb, ChatticusMarketing in legacy, still UPDATE_COMPLETE or CREATE_COMPLETE) belong to the legacy retirement under chatticus-2e4d79. Do not delete other projects secrets in the legacy account (kanbus, b0rd, amplify, sierrendipity, SessionKey, GoogleOAuthSecret of AuritusBackend are not Chatticus). Method when approved: scheduled deletion with a 30-day recovery window (not force delete), after confirming no Lambda or stack in that account references the ARN. Saves 4.00 USD per month for 10 secrets.

comments.text: Owner approved; executed 2026-10-23. OLD STAGING account: scheduled for deletion with a 30-day recovery window (recovery deadline 2026-11-21): OperatorKeyD7C0C4F2-3Fvk..., InvokeKey581783BE-YvSy..., chatticus/staging/oauth/google. Verified before deleting: names and stack tags match, no Chatticus stack or Lambda exists in that account, none of its 25 stack templates reference them. LEGACY account: all seven SKIPPED under rule D2 because live references exist: InvokeKey581783BE-wdTS... (imported by stack ChatticusWeb via ChatticusThinTurn export, plus live ChatticusThinTurn Lambdas); OperatorKeyD7C0C4F2-IUHi... (resolved into CHATTICUS_OPERATOR_KEY of the live ChatticusThinTurn FrontDoor Lambda); InvokeKey581783BE-P6oU... and -YdDX... (resolved into live ThinTurnStaging and ThinTurnProduction Lambdas and stack resources); chatticus/{development,staging,production}/oauth/google (resolved by live stacks ChatticusAuth, ChatticusAuthStaging, ChatticusAuthProduction; a stack update would fail without them). These wait on the legacy stack retirement under chatticus-2e4d79; delete after those stacks are gone. Restore within the window: aws secretsmanager restore-secret --secret-id NAME --profile chatticus-staging --region us-east-1. No force-delete, no values read, nothing else touched.
